_doc: Start weights (StarVLA backbones) of the model line's downstream runs: the downstream line's start registry in the same form (VAGEN-Lite-downstream/downstream/starts.json, not edited), one entry per start; code names B / S / RS / RD with the model in front (Q3 = Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, CS = Cambrian-S-7B). Paths are read only, never copied. The SFT and RL starts are added when step 3 has them.

Q3B.desc: original Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (HF revision 0c351dd0; four shards' sha256 checked 2026-10-24, job pt-v2kaero2)

CSB.desc: original Cambrian-S-7B (nyu-visionx/Cambrian-S-7B, revision 556e72fd, from hf-mirror.com 2026-10-24; sizes and sha256 checked against huggingface.co's manifest)

Q3S.desc: Qwen3-VL-8B after the model line's formal SFT (C0's data and recipe, new format), epoch 8 picked by validation (chain m_qwen3vl8b_formal_sft_20261026); the user's decision 23 of 2026-10-27

Q3RD.desc: Qwen3-VL-8B after the formal RL dense arm (V4, 300 updates from Q3S), update 300 picked by validation (chain m_qwen3vl8b_formal_rl_20261026); the user's decision 23 of 2026-10-27

CSS.desc: Cambrian-S-7B after the model line's formal SFT (as Q3S), epoch 5 picked by validation (chain m_cambrian7b_formal_sft_20261026); the user's decision 23 of 2026-10-27

Q3RS.label: S0 第 100 次（该臂第 150 次走样停下）
Q3RS.desc: Qwen3-VL-8B after the formal RL S0 arm, update 100 (the arm was stopped by format drift at update 150; chain m_qwen3vl8b_formal_rl_20261026); the user's decision 4 of 2026-10-27

CSRS.label: S0 第 100 次（该臂第 122 次走样停下）
CSRS.desc: Cambrian-S-7B after the formal RL S0 arm, update 100 (the arm was stopped by format drift at update 122; chain m_cambrian7b_formal_rl_20261026); the user's decision 4 of 2026-10-27
